document.querySelector('.modal') : P.lastResult) return; await sleep(200); } }; const closeAll = () => document.querySelectorAll('.modal-close-button, .modal-container .modal-header-button').forEach((b) => b.click()); const quiet = () => { P.watcher.stop(); P.watcher.lastEdit.clear(); P.watcher.base.clear(); }; const fresh = async (s, pro) => { closeAll(); quiet(); await settings({}); await restore(); await sleep(2500); quiet(); closeAll(); await settings(s); await setPro(pro); P.lastResult = null; document.querySelectorAll('.notice').forEach((n) => n.remove()); }; await fresh({}, false); await open('Project Plan.md'); await retype('## Milestones', 3, 'Roadmap'); await done(false); await sleep(300); return 'ok'; })()
